gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i3: Tolerance of one unit in the last place: results must match to full double precision.
ADDED i4: Tolerance for assertions that must match the expected value exactly.
ADDED i5: Default sigmoid: lower asymptote 0, higher asymptote 1.
ADDED i6: The default sigmoid is symmetric about x = 0, where it equals the midpoint 0.5, and saturates to its asymptotes at the infinities.
ADDED i7: Evaluate the default sigmoid and its derivative at x = 0 (1 variable, order 1, variable index 0, value 0.0).
ADDED i8: The first derivative of the default sigmoid peaks at x = 0 with value 0.25.
ADDED i9: Sigmoid with asymptotes [1, 3], evaluated together with its first five derivatives (1 variable, order 5, variable index 0, value 1.2).
ADDED i10: Reference values for the function and its successive derivatives at x = 1.2.
ADDED i11: For arguments far from the origin (and at the extreme finite/infinite values), the sigmoid is saturated, so its first derivative vanishes.
ADDED i12: value() requires exactly two parameters (lower and higher asymptote).
ADDED i13: gradient() requires exactly two parameters (lower and higher asymptote).
ADDED i14: A configured Sigmoid and the Parametric form fed the same asymptotes must agree at every point.
